install_salina_package: install the salina python package using pip install from the local setup.py file
build_salina_wheel: build a wheel distribution of the salina package using python setup.py bdist_wheel
list_salina_deps: list the install requirements for the salina package from requirements.txt
review_setup_config: review the setup.py configuration for the salina package including name version and dependencies
summarize_setup_py: summarize the salina setup.py file to understand package metadata and dependencies
